papers.title_zh: Antares：代理漏洞定位的基础模型
papers.summary_zh: 漏洞定位是软件安全的基本步骤，需要模型对大型代码库进行推理并迭代识别易受攻击的实现。我们推出了 Antares，这是一个用于代理漏洞定位的紧凑语言模型系列（350M、1B 和 3B 参数）。 Antares 基于 IBM Granite 基本模型，通过两阶段管道进行训练，该管道将网络安全推理和存储库探索数据的监督微调与易受攻击存储库的可验证奖励的强化学习结合起来。经过广泛的评估，Antares-3B 接近 GPT-5.5，同时性能优于尺寸大 200 倍以上的开放重量模型。 Antares 系列进一步实现了快速、低成本的本地推理，在单个 H100 GPU 上大约 15 分钟内完成完整的 500 个任务评估扫描，相当于每项任务的摊销评估时间不到 2 秒且不到 0.002 美元。

papers.title: USP-Mamba: Unmixing-Derived Spectral and Structural Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
papers.summary: Hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution imagery while preserving dense spectral information. Recently, Mamba-based models have shown promising potential for this task by capturing long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. Nevertheless, their causal sequence modeling requires two-dimensional hyperspectral features to be unfolded along predefined scanning orders, which disrupts spatial adjacency and restricts the effective propagation of contextual information. Moreover, state-space parameterization of existing models is predominantly derived from generic learned representations, without explicit alignment with the intrinsic characteristics of the hyperspectral image. To address this issue, we propose an Unmixing-derived Spectral and Structural Prompting Mamba framework, termed USP-Mamba, which adapts Mamba state evolution through composition-aware spectral priors and image-dependent structural prompts. Specifically, an unmixing-informed spectral prompt captures the global material composition of the input image and provides persistent conditioning throughout reconstruction. Injected into the Mamba sequence and progressively adapted across layers, it steers state evolution toward composition-consistent reconstruction. We introduce feature-level structural prompts comprising spatial and frequency components to provide image-dependent local guidance. The spatial prompt promotes structure-sensitive state encoding for local detail preservation, while the frequency prompt enables region-adaptive transitions between homogeneous regions and high-frequency details. Finally, complementary Hilbert and Semantic-Guided Neighboring scans preserve spatial continuity and strengthen non-local semantic dependency modeling. Extensive experiments on different datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative approaches.
papers.title_zh: USP-Mamba：用于高光谱图像超分辨率的解混合衍生光谱和结构提示
papers.summary_zh: 高光谱图像超分辨率旨在重建高分辨率图像，同时保留密集的光谱信息。最近，基于 Mamba 的模型通过捕获具有线性计算复杂性的远程依赖关系，在这项任务上显示出了巨大的潜力。然而，他们的因果序列建模需要沿着预定义的扫描顺序展开二维高光谱特征，这破坏了空间相邻性并限制了上下文信息的有效传播。此外，现有模型的状态空间参数化主要来自通用的学习表示，没有与高光谱图像的内在特征明确对齐。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于分解的光谱和结构提示 Mamba 框架，称为 USP-Mamba，它通过组合感知光谱先验和图像相关的结构提示来适应 Mamba 状态演化。具体来说，未混合通知的光谱提示捕获输入图像的全局材料成分，并在整个重建过程中提供持久的调节。注入曼巴序列并逐步跨层适应，它引导状态进化向组成一致的重建。我们引入了包含空间和频率分量的特征级结构提示，以提供依赖于图像的局部指导。空间提示促进结构敏感的状态编码以保留局部细节，而频率提示则实现均匀区域和高频细节之间的区域自适应过渡。最后，互补的希尔伯特和语义引导邻近扫描保留了空间连续性并加强了非局部语义依赖建模。对不同数据集的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法始终优于代表性方法。

papers.title: Joint Retrieval of Radial Wind, Terminal Fall Velocity, and Median Diameter From Single-Polarization Fast-Scanning Weather Radar
papers.summary: The inverse problem of precipitation retrieval from Doppler power spectral density measurements of a fast-scanning single-polarization X-band weather radar is addressed. The formulation is developed around quantities that remain interpretable and stable across short coherent processing intervals: radial-wind mean, radial-wind spectral width, reflectivity-weighted terminal fall velocity, and median volume diameter. The gamma drop-size distribution parameters are retained as latent variables within the spectral forward model rather than reported as primary retrieval products. This choice is motivated by likelihood analyses showing that the inverse problem is weakly identifiable with respect to the latent distribution parameters, whereas the derived quantities remain substantially more stable. Simulated-data experiments compare the proposed approach with a moment-based retrieval using externally supplied wind information in the short-coherent-processing-interval regime. Real-data experiments demonstrate same-scan spatial likelihood pooling through a one-scan plan-position-indicator retrieval and 33-scan time-series comparisons against two disdrometers within the radar coverage region. The results show that the latent distribution parameters should be treated as intermediate fitting variables rather than primary end products. The proposed approach shows its clearest practical benefit for median volume diameter and reflectivity-weighted terminal fall velocity under incoherent short-record operation. Spatial pooling allows efficient full-scan mapping of both quantities when each Doppler spectrum contains only a few slow-time samples. Radar-disdrometer discrepancies remain physically meaningful even when the spectral fit and temporal evolution are reasonable.

papers.title_zh: 单偏振快速扫描气象雷达联合反演径向风、末落速度和中值直径
papers.summary_zh: 解决了快速扫描单偏振 X 波段天气雷达的多普勒功率谱密度测量的降水反演问题。该公式是围绕在短相干处理间隔内保持可解释和稳定的量而开发的：径向风平均值、径向风谱宽度、反射率加权终端下落速度和中值体积直径。伽玛液滴尺寸分布参数保留为光谱前向模型中的潜在变量，而不是报告为主要检索产品。这种选择的动机是似然分析表明，就潜在分布参数而言，逆问题的可识别性较弱，而导出的量则基本上保持更稳定。模拟数据实验将所提出的方法与在短相干处理间隔范围内使用外部提供的风信息的基于矩的检索进行比较。真实数据实验通过单次扫描计划位置指示器检索和 33 次扫描时间序列与雷达覆盖区域内的两个测距仪进行比较，证明了同扫描空间似然池化。结果表明，潜在分布参数应被视为中间拟合变量而不是初级最终产品。所提出的方法显示了在不相干短记录操作下对中值体积直径和反射率加权终端下落速度的最明显的实际好处。当每个多普勒频谱仅包含一些慢速样本时，空间池可以对两个量进行有效的全扫描映射。即使光谱拟合和时间演化合理，雷达-测速仪差异仍然具有物理意义。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Representations for Binary Program Clustering: From Empirical Study to Retrieval-Augmented Learning
papers.summary: Malware clustering is a critical task in cybersecurity that helps discover threats and analyze evolving malware families. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and tabular representation learning (TRL) have achieved breakthroughs in other domains, their application to binary program clustering (the task of clustering all incoming samples regardless of label) remains largely unexplored. This study presents the first systematic investigation of SSL and TRL methods for binary program clustering, conducted in two phases on the public Ember and Bodmas datasets. In Phase 1, we establish a performance ceiling by adapting prominent vision-based SSL models (BYOL, SimSiam, Barlow Twins, VICReg) for tabular data with supervised pair generation, finding that BYOL and SimSiam achieve performance comparable to fully supervised models, while Barlow Twins and VICReg significantly underperform. In Phase 2, we evaluate purely unsupervised TRL methods against strong baselines (PCA, Autoencoder, UMAP), demonstrating that VIME establishes a new state of the art for binary program clustering. Informed by these findings, we propose VIME-R, a retrieval-augmented extension of VIME that replaces random marginal-distribution corruption with retrieval-based augmentation to generate more informative training pairs. VIME-R further improves upon VIME, achieving 2.7\%-5.8\% higher Homogeneity on both datasets. Our results highlight retrieval-augmented tabular representation learning as a promising direction for enhancing automated malware analysis. Code will be made available.
papers.title_zh: 二元程序聚类的自监督表示：从实证研究到检索增强学习
papers.summary_zh: 恶意软件集群是网络安全中的一项关键任务，有助于发现威胁并分析不断演变的恶意软件家族。虽然自监督学习 (SSL) 和表格表示学习 (TRL) 在其他领域取得了突破，但它们在二进制程序聚类（对所有输入样本进行聚类的任务，无论标签如何）的应用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究首次对二进制程序聚类的 SSL 和 TRL 方法进行了系统研究，该研究分两个阶段在公共 Ember 和 Bodmas 数据集上进行。在第一阶段，我们通过将著名的基于视觉的 SSL 模型（BYOL、SimSiam、Barlow Twins、VICReg）应用于具有监督对生成的表格数据来建立性能上限，发现 BYOL 和 SimSiam 的性能与完全监督模型相当，而 Barlow Twins 和 VICReg 的性能明显较差。在第 2 阶段，我们根据强基线（PCA、自动编码器、UMAP）评估纯粹无监督的 TRL 方法，证明 VIME 为二进制程序聚类建立了新的技术水平。根据这些发现，我们提出了 VIME-R，这是 VIME 的检索增强扩展，它用基于检索的增强取代随机边缘分布损坏，以生成信息更丰富的训练对。 VIME-R 在 VIME 的基础上进一步改进，在两个数据集上实现了 2.7\%-5.8\% 的同质性提高。我们的结果强调检索增强表格表示学习是增强自动化恶意软件分析的一个有前途的方向。代码将可用。

papers.title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
papers.summary: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.
papers.comment: 19 pages, preprint
papers.title_zh: 具有分层记忆的 Mamba：解决长序列建模中的表示瓶颈
papers.summary_zh: Mamba 等循环线性注意力模型 (RLA) 提供了高效的线性时间序列建模作为 Transformer 的替代方案，但其固定容量的循环状态限制了长序列建模。从人类分层记忆中汲取灵感，我们提出了分层记忆曼巴（HMM）来解决这一限制。 HMM 基于预先训练的 Mamba 主干网络，集成了轻量级工作记忆，可从嵌入主干隐藏状态的快速感觉记忆中提取慢速段落级语义 (PLS)。 PLS 随后被压缩到持久的长期记忆中，用于任务相关的检索。语义信息的分层处理克服了 RLA 的表示瓶颈，并通过参数学习赋予 HMM 跨任务泛化能力，这是其他长上下文增强 Mamba 变体中未观察到的。对密钥检索和 LongBench-E 任务的评估表明，与基于 Mamba 的强大模型相比，HMM 将检索成功率提高了 34.3--37.1%，推理准确性提高了 1.6--14.2%，同时仅添加 2% 的额外参数，并且训练开销最小。

papers.title: Global-Scale Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for NDVI Time-Series Reconstruction
papers.summary: Accurate and efficient reconstruction of cloud-contaminated and noise-corrupted NDVI time series remains a challenge in remote sensing. Deep learning provides a promising solution for modeling complex spatiotemporal dependencies; however, its application is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining paired clear-sky and degraded NDVI data for identical spatiotemporal locations. To address this issue, we propose GloSSR, a Global-scale Self-supervised Spatiotemporal framework for NDVI Reconstruction. The framework constructs supervisory signals by artificially degrading relatively clean NDVI observations with realistic cloud contamination patterns, producing self-supervised training pairs that closely mimic real-world degradation. It further introduces an end-to-end spatiotemporal learning network that jointly captures long-range temporal dependencies and short-term spatiotemporal correlation through a bidirectional Transformer with a ConvLSTM architecture. A temporal-channel attention-based reconstruction module is incorporated to enhance informative features, while a spatiotemporal prior constraint is designed to preserve both fine-scale structures and long-term phenological trends during optimization. Extensive evaluations on MODIS NDVI data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework across both artificial and real-world scenarios. In artificial degraded-pixel reconstruction experiments, GloSSR consistently outperforms the comparison methods. Time-series analyses based on real observations further demonstrate that the proposed framework can accurately characterize vegetation dynamics and capture the key phenological states. Long-term vegetation trend analysis and the transferability analysis to AVHRR data validate the scalability of the framework and illustrate its broad applicability for large-scale environmental monitoring.
papers.title_zh: 用于 NDVI 时间序列重建的全球规模自监督时空学习
papers.summary_zh: 准确有效地重建受云污染和噪声破坏的 NDVI 时间序列仍然是遥感领域的一个挑战。深度学习为复杂时空依赖性建模提供了一种有前途的解决方案；然而，其应用常常受到难以获得相同时空位置的配对晴空和退化 NDVI 数据的限制。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 GloSSR，一种用于 NDVI 重建的全球范围自监督时空框架。该框架通过人为地降低具有真实云污染模式的相对干净的 NDVI 观测值来构建监督信号，生成密切模仿现实世界退化的自我监督训练对。它还引入了一个端到端时空学习网络，通过具有 ConvLSTM 架构的双向 Transformer 联合捕获长期时间依赖性和短期时空相关性。结合了基于时间通道注意的重建模块来增强信息特征，同时设计时空先验约束来在优化过程中保留精细尺度结构和长期物候趋势。对 MODIS NDVI 数据的广泛评估证明了所提出的框架在人工和现实场景中的有效性。在人工退化像素重建实验中，GloSSR 始终优于比较方法。基于真实观测的时间序列分析进一步表明，所提出的框架可以准确地表征植被动态并捕获关键的物候状态。长期植被趋势分析和 AVHRR 数据的可转移性分析验证了该框架的可扩展性，并说明了其在大规模环境监测中的广泛适用性。

papers.title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
papers.summary: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the system's understanding of the task and guides solution improvement. We instantiate this paradigm in Iris, an inquiry-revision loop. For information acquisition, Iris generates local action plans from the current information state and uses epistemic actions to probe decision-critical unknowns without modifying the retained solution. For information management, Iris synthesizes observations across experiments into task knowledge composed of revisable claims with explicit scope and status. It updates this knowledge as new evidence arrives and constructs each decision context from raw evidence, structured summaries, or task knowledge at the required level of detail. On MLE-Bench, Iris attains a 64.9% any-medal rate under a 12-hour budget, the highest among compared systems. Across four tasks spanning harness engineering and model post-training, Iris also demonstrates cross-domain generalization.
papers.title_zh: 超越以解决方案为中心的搜索：自主机器学习工程的自适应查询和知识修订
papers.summary_zh: 机器学习工程等长期自主研究任务要求系统在有限的预算下做出相互依赖的决策。现有的基于 LLM 的代理通常通过树、图或链结构来组织候选解决方案改进，这意味着搜索过程决定如何获取和管理信息。我们将这种设计称为以解决方案为中心的搜索，并提出了信息范式，其中不断变化的信息状态代表系统对任务的理解并指导解决方案的改进。我们在 Iris 中实例化了这种范例，这是一个查询-修改循环。对于信息获取，Iris 从当前信息状态生成本地行动计划，并使用认知行动来探索决策关键的未知因素，而无需修改保留的解决方案。对于信息管理，Iris 将实验中的观察结果综合为由具有明确范围和状态的可修改声明组成的任务知识。当新证据到达时，它会更新这些知识，并根据原始证据、结构化摘要或任务知识以所需的详细程度构建每个决策上下文。在 MLE-Bench 上，Iris 在 12 小时预算下获得了 64.9% 的任意奖牌率，是比较系统中最高的。在涵盖线束工程和模型后训练的四项任务中，Iris 还展示了跨领域泛化能力。

papers.title: Mapping melliferous tree species in Kenya via one-class classification with hyperspectral unsupervised domain adaptation
papers.summary: The beekeeping sector holds significant potential for livelihood diversification among the agropastoral communities in Kenya. Melliferous tree species play a critical role by providing essential nectar sources for bees. However, limited knowledge of their precise spatial distributions constrains the full development of beekeeping. One-class classification (OCC) offers a practical solution for detecting single target species without requiring extensive labeled data from other classes. Although existing OCC methods perform well in trained domains, the generalization capability to unseen domains remains limited due to domain shift. To address these challenges, this study proposes a hyperspectral unsupervised domain adaptation OCC framework (HyUDA-One) for tree species mapping using airborne hyperspectral imagery and laser scanning data. The spatial-spectral regularized pseudo-positive learning was designed to mitigate domain shift and improve model generalizability. The effectiveness of HyUDA-One was demonstrated by mapping three key melliferous tree species in two savanna landscapes in southern Kenya. The results show that HyUDA-One significantly improves performance in unlabeled domains. The F1-scores of 0.788, 0.845, and 0.768 were achieved for Senegalia mellifera, Vachellia tortilis, and Commiphora africana in the trained domain, respectively. In the untrained domain, the F1-scores of Senegalia mellifera and Vachellia tortilis were 0.756 and 0.884, respectively. The distribution maps revealed the spatial patterns of these melliferous tree species and the nectar source availability, offering an important reference for sustainable beekeeping development in savanna landscapes. Furthermore, the proposed framework can potentially be extended to other mapping applications, such as invasive species detection.

papers.title_zh: 通过高光谱无监督域适应的一类分类绘制肯尼亚的芳香树种图
papers.summary_zh: 养蜂业对于肯尼亚农牧社区的生计多样化具有巨大潜力。多汁树种在为蜜蜂提供必需的花蜜来源方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，对其精确空间分布的了解有限，限制了养蜂业的全面发展。一类分类 (OCC) 提供了一种实用的解决方案，用于检测单一目标物种，而不需要来自其他类别的大量标记数据。尽管现有的 OCC 方法在训练有素的领域中表现良好，但由于领域转移，对未见领域的泛化能力仍然有限。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种高光谱无监督域适应 OCC 框架 (HyUDA-One)，用于使用机载高光谱图像和激光扫描数据进行树种测绘。空间谱正则化伪正学习旨在减轻域转移并提高模型的泛化性。 HyUDA-One 的有效性通过在肯尼亚南部的两个稀树草原景观中绘制三种主要的芳香树种的地图来证明。结果表明，HyUDA-One 显着提高了未标记域的性能。在训练域中，Senegalalia mellifera、Vachellia tortilis 和 Commiphora africana 的 F1 分数分别为 0.788、0.845 和 0.768。在未经训练的域中，Senegalalia mellifera 和 Vachellia tortilis 的 F1 分数分别为 0.756 和 0.884。分布图揭示了这些蜜源树种的空间格局和蜜源可用性，为稀树草原景观可持续养蜂业发展提供了重要参考。此外，所提出的框架有可能扩展到其他绘图应用，例如入侵物种检测。

papers.title: DART: Decoded Attention over Recurrent States for Efficient Long-Context Sequence Modeling
papers.summary: Modern language models are built primarily from Transformers, recurrent models, and their hybrid architectures. Transformers rely on token-level attention memories, while recurrent models such as state space models (SSMs) and linear attention maintain compact recurrent states. These architectures are typically instantiated separately or interleaved at the layer level, leaving open whether a shared memory representation can support both recurrent compression and attention-style retrieval. We study this question through the state space duality (SSD) view of Mamba-2, where the SSM state can be interpreted as a compressed associative key--value (KV) cache. We observe that Mamba-2 decodes token-conditioned values from this state but does not decode token-conditioned keys. Based on this observation, we propose DART (Decoded Attention over Recurrent sTates), which retains the chunk state contributions produced by the Mamba-2 chunked scan as chunk state memories, decodes token-conditioned keys and values from these memories, and performs state-memory attention (SMA) over the resulting KV pairs. The retrieved output is then combined with the native Mamba-2 output through a gated residual connection. DART supports practical training by reusing the Mamba-2 chunked scan and implementing SMA as a FlashAttention-style computation. Our analysis and experiments show that DART substantially reduces the length-dependent inference cache compared with a matched attention baseline (e.g., $75\%$ savings when the chunk size is $S=256$ and the state size is $N=128$). Compared with Mamba-2, DART substantially improves associative recall and retrieval while preserving general language-modeling quality.
papers.title_zh: DART：解码循环状态的注意力以实现高效的长上下文序列建模
papers.summary_zh: 现代语言模型主要由 Transformer、循环模型及其混合架构构建。 Transformer 依赖于 token 级注意力记忆，而诸如状态空间模型（SSM）和线性注意力之类的循环模型则维持紧凑的循环状态。这些架构通常在层级别单独实例化或交错，从而使共享内存表示是否可以支持循环压缩和注意力式检索保持开放。我们通过 Mamba-2 的状态空间对偶 (SSD) 视图来研究这个问题，其中 SSM 状态可以解释为压缩的关联键值 (KV) 缓存。我们观察到 Mamba-2 从该状态解码令牌条件值，但不解码令牌条件密钥。基于这一观察，我们提出了 DART（Decoded Attention over Recurrent sTates），它将 Mamba-2 分块扫描产生的块状态贡献保留为块状态记忆，从这些记忆中解码令牌条件键和值，并对生成的 KV 对执行状态记忆注意力（SMA）。然后，检索到的输出通过门控残差连接与本机 Mamba-2 输出组合。 DART 通过重用 Mamba-2 分块扫描并将 SMA 实现为 FlashAttention 式计算来支持实际训练。我们的分析和实验表明，与匹配的注意力基线相比，DART 大大减少了长度相关的推理缓存（例如，当块大小为 $S=256$ 且状态大小为 $N=128$ 时，节省 $75\%$）。与 Mamba-2 相比，DART 显着提高了联想回忆和检索，同时保留了一般语言建模质量。
